description:
Situated in the heart of Cockermouth, this Grade II listed spacious first floor flat offers a perfect blend of historic charm and modern convenience. The property features a private hall and staircase leading to a front-to-back living room with space for a home office, a fitted kitchen with a walk-in pantry, a bathroom with a three-piece suite, and a comfortable double bedroom.

Residents can benefit from the convenience of a car park at the rear where permits are available for purchase.

This property is ideal for first-time buyers or investors looking to own a piece of Cockermouth's popular conservation area. Cockermouth, a picturesque Georgian town, is renowned as the gateway to the Western Lake District and the Solway Coast, offering easy access to stunning natural landscapes and a wealth of amenities. With its historic streets, independent shops, diverse eateries, cultural venues like the Kirkgate Centre, and literary heritage at Wordsworth House and Garden, Cockermouth provides a vibrant and welcoming community for residents to enjoy.

Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to riverside walks, the Lake District National Park, Whinlatter Forest, and cycling routes.

Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity - contact us today to arrange a viewing.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
